---
title: "Gray-Scott Model"
subtitle: "Block 9+: Exploring richer pattern dynamics"
---

## Field Dynamics

The Gray-Scott model uses autocatalytic reaction with feed/kill dynamics:

$$
\frac{\partial U}{\partial t} = D_u \nabla^2 U - UV^2 + F(1-U)
$$

$$
\frac{\partial V}{\partial t} = D_v \nabla^2 V + UV^2 - (F+k)V
$$

where:

- $U$ is the "feed" species (replenished at rate $F$)
- $V$ is the "autocatalyst" (self-replicating via $UV^2$)
- $F$ is the feed rate
- $k$ is the kill rate

### Pattern Regimes (Pearson 1993)

| Regime | F | k | Pattern |
|--------|---|---|---------|
| α (alpha) | 0.010 | 0.047 | Spots |
| β (beta) | 0.026 | 0.052 | Replicating spots |
| γ (gamma) | 0.035 | 0.060 | Worms/labyrinths |
| δ (delta) | 0.028 | 0.053 | Mitosis |
| ε (epsilon) | 0.018 | 0.055 | Chaotic |
| λ (lambda) | 0.040 | 0.065 | Stripes |

### Parameters

| Symbol | Description | Current | Range |
|--------|-------------|---------|-------|
| $D_u$ | U diffusion | 0.20 | 0.1–0.5 |
| $D_v$ | V diffusion | 0.10 | 0.05–0.2 |
| $F$ | Feed rate | 0.035 | 0.01–0.06 |
| $k$ | Kill rate | 0.060 | 0.04–0.07 |
| time_scale | Dynamics speed | 5.0 | 1–10 |

---

## Particle Coupling

Same diffusiophoretic dynamics as Brusselator, but with U and V fields:

$$
\mathbf{v}_i = M_1 \nabla U\big|_{\mathbf{x}_i} + M_2 \nabla V\big|_{\mathbf{x}_i} + \sqrt{\frac{2}{\text{Pe}}} \boldsymbol{\eta}(t)
$$

::: {.callout-warning}
## Coupling Challenge
Gray-Scott's $UV^2$ production is slow compared to particle consumption rates tuned for Brusselator. V field goes negative, causing anti-clustering and eventual NaN.

**Solutions being tested:**
- V-clamping (concentration ≥ 0)
- Inverted coupling (consume U instead of V)
- Reduced consumption rates
:::

---

## Current Status

Block 9 showed Gray-Scott produces **excellent** U-field patterns (hexagonal spots, labyrinths) and particles **do** trace field boundaries correctly. However, particle-field coupling destabilizes the system.

| Iteration | Configuration | Result |
|-----------|---------------|--------|
| 65 | Initial test | Anti-clustering, V negative |
| 66 | α-spot regime | NaN explosion |
| 67 | γ-worm regime | V deeply negative |
| 73 | V-clamping code mod | U still negative |
| 74 | Reduced consumption | Still unstable |
